notes.title: [PATCH 0.2.008] SHOTGUN AND MACHETE
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

The shotgun and machete are finally here! Let us know what you think about them, so we can tune stuff and make them more fun!

Shotgun: A new gun is available in the shop. Its a shotgun, pretty self explanatory.

Machete: All players now have a machette they can access at any time. Press V, Middle Mouse Button, or either side mouse buttons to access it whenever you want. It does a good bit of damage and can save you in a pinch.

Other small changes:


 Keybinds have been updated to show the new keybinds for quick access to menus, weapons etc.

 Controller inverted aim should now work.

notes.title: [PATCH 0.2.007] Exploding Barrels, Inverted Aim, New ADS settings, and more!
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

We've been working to add as many things as we can based on your feedback! A few new updates are:

Exploding Barrels: Red barrels can be found across the map! Shooting these will cause them to explode, killing enemies AND players, so be careful! They can be pretty useful if shot at the right time!

Landmine update: Shooting a landmine will now kill any enemies that are near it. Use that wisely!

Inverted Aim setting: You can find a new setting in controls called inverted aim. This will change aim control on the gun, but not in the menus. Let us know if this is what players looking for inverted controls wanted!

Scope changes: Scopes have been re-adjusted on all guns to be closer to the player based on your feedback. This should make them easier to use!

ADS Zoom: You may notice that when aiming down sights, the game will now zoom in much more. This change was based on your feedback! If you like how it was before, don't worry, in controls you can find a setting to change it from Zoom to Normal!

High Framerate Mode: This is an experimental setting, but you can now set the framerate much higher. If you are experiencing lag in multiplayer, please change this back to 60 FPS.


NOTE: Video settings will be reset with this update. VRAM setting has been changed to default 512mb. Please keep this setting as is, unless you have a high end graphics card. This should fix the VRAM crashing issue for most players affected by it.

Bug Fixes:


 Brightness should no longer reset after you die.
 Voice settings should no longer reset after you die.
 Tools should no longer disappear if changing to something while having the camera out and activated.
 Landmines have a more reliable hitbox now, making them easier to shoot.



Note:

We wanted to have the leveling system in this weekend, but Lily has to travel next week and didn't want to push an update that could cause any serious bugs. We will get that into the game soon, and also will be holding a vote in our Discord to name the next map, which is almost complete! 

Thank again for all your support, feedback, and reviews. We are almost at the 50 review milestone, and are super grateful to all of you! Let us know anything you want to see added, addressed, etc.

notes.title: [PATCH 0.2.006] Quality of Life update, Store descriptions, and more!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

This update includes a few things people have been asking for. The stores in game now display descriptions for items and purchasing is faster. Achievements have also been fixed!


 All items in stores now have descriptions of what they do, so you don't have to buy them first to know what they do.

 You can now buy items in the stores much faster.

 Stash in the lobby is now fixed, and should no longer delete the bottom row.

 We have fixed up the Achievements, and added a few more! You should now be able to unlock the achievements. If you have already bought all skins, next update will include a few more skins so you can unlock those two!


Next weeks update will include the new level system, and custom titles! Sorry we couldn't get to it this week. But it will be added soon!

Thanks again for all the support you have shown us. The feedback has been super helpful and fun to implement into the game! We are on our quest for 50 reviews, and appreciate all the kind words you guys have left us!

Please let us know if there are more things you would like to see, or any issues you are having. Thanks guys!

notes.title: [PATCH 0.2.005] Score Screen Updates, Reworked Rewards, and more!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! This week we tried to tackle a few more things people have been asking for. The new score and ranking system will help make looting the entire zone more worthwhile, as you can earn ranks and bonus payouts for completely clearing the map.

Score and Ranking System: You will now receive a ranking and bonus payouts based on how well you played during each contract. Try to earn an S rank by completing all objectives, and with every modifier enabled! You can view these scores in the lobby on the new TV screen!

You can press "L" to view the current objective completion rates on your PDA at any time.

Headshots: Headshots have been increased across all weapons.

Enemy Physics: In preparation for the new Shotgun weapon we are working on, we've started testing physics reactions on enemies when they are killed! When you kill an enemy, they should now react in the appropriate direction that you shot them in. Players said they wanted enemies to react more, so we are working on that. First step is this new physics system!

Minor Stuff


 New loading, extraction, and failure screens have been added.

 A direct link to our Discord has been added to the main lobby screen.

notes.title: [PATCH 0.2.004] MORE MUTATIONS, AND MORE MODIFIERS!
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

As a thank you for the 1000 sales, we have changed the First 100 skins to match the new First 1000 skins! They are much cooler, and sparkle too. You can claim these new skins at the Gentleman Skelton in the Lobby for the next week or so, free of charge!

We have been hard at work making new enemy types to add variety and scares to the game. There are two new mutations for you to deal with as of now!

Weeper: A tall, creepy monster you can find weeping throughout the map. He can't be hurt, but he will leave you alone if you sneak past him. He is completely blind, so don't make noise around him and be sure to crouch! Otherwise, he will attack you and deal health + sanity damage.

Phasmaghast: If you stay within EMF range 5 for too long, a phasmaghast will spawn to protect the anomaly. These cannot be harmed either, and will hunt you down for a short period of time. If you hear your heart start beating, whispers from the void, and your eyesight darkens, RUN! You can see them blink in and out of existence with a misty red silhoutte.

We have also added three new modifiers to make the game more difficult!


 Faulty: The generator will now break much faster!
 Confusion: The TV displaying the anomaly location is broken! You've gotta find it on your own now!
 Callused: Enemies now have much more health! Let us know how this feels, we can always make it harder!


Quality of Life:


 Performance Booster: You can now set a performance booster setting, to dynamically change the active resolution. 
 Arachnophobia Mode: You can now choose to disable spider spawns on the contract computer.
 Headshots that kill enemies now explode heads on all guns!
 You can now press J to access evidence log directly.
 You can now press K to access emote log directly.
 All enemies now make "breathing" noises once agro'd. This make them much easier to hear from behind you!
 New skins have been added to the suit store!
 Further optimizations in both multiplayer and the lobby. Fixed a massive polygon issue that should cut down nearly 4 Million triangles in parties of 4! Our bad.
 Lighting during the final storm shouldn't cast shadows anymore, should fix some stutters some players were having during those storms.
 Player tombstones have been added for those who have helped us find boundary breaks!


Bug Fixes:


 Enemies can no longer walk through the extraction truck.
 Kullgrove foliage clipping has been fixed.
 Bonus objective should now trigger correctly.
 Dropping gems/artifacts/stuff from a ledge should no longer cause it to disappear. It should be down on the ground!

notes.title: [PATCH 0.2.003] NEW MUTATIONS HAVE APPEARED! THANK YOU FOR 1000 SALES!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! First we would like to say thank you so much for helping us pass 1000 sales on Steam! We have been blown away by your support, and all the helpful feedback you have given us! You can find a new stage in the lobby, that will do something if you click that green button! New first 1000 skins are on their way too, with an update to the first 100 skins as well.

One of the common things we've been asked is to increase enemy variety and up the scary factor of the game. The next few patches will be focused mostly on adding new enemies and scares. In this patch:


 Corpse Eater: A new large monster that has a chance to spawn near corpse piles. You can sneak past him, or choose to engage! He is always guarding something valuable.



 Gremlin: A new small monster who likes to hide in small places and around corners. They will charge at you without warning, so be careful!


More changes we've made:


 Biomass now has its own system message to make it easier to see when you are harvesting.
 Biomass now shakes while being harvested, to make it clearer to the player you are harvesting it.
 Biomass now spawns across the entire map to reward exploration more, and appears as a purple dot on your scanner.
 Players can no longer enter teleporters with the anomaly extraction tool on their backs.
 More texture fixes and pop in fixes.
 Special rewards from special jobs now have a clearly marked icon to help players find the rewards.
 All special jobs now have their own "System Messages" to explain what to do and make them less confusing.
 We are updating the UI, starting with the main HUD. We will keep trying to make the UI nicer!


We want to thank all of you once again for your help and support! We read every review and are trying to make the game as fun as we can. Please let us know what you think of the new enemies, and if you have any suggestions on them!

notes.title: [PATCH 0.2.002] More quality of life, and bug fixes.
notes.content:
Hey everybody, we are still just working on implementing player feedback requests and bug fixes!


 You will now automatically drop whatever you are holding by pulling our your weapon or tools!
 You can press Shift + Left mouse button to auto loot stuff from chests.
 You can press CNTRL + Left mouse button to split stacks of items.
 Flashlight should no longer clip into third person characters.
 Flashlight is now turned on by default.
 Tutorial has been updated.
 Tutorial no longer shows "System Messages" on top of the tutorial text.
 The eyeball haunting monster has been disabled for now, until we find a better way to communicate its presence to the player.


Thanks again for all the feedback! Please let us know if you are experiencing issues, or have anything you would like to see changed/added to make the game more fun! We are on our path to 50 reviews, and have managed to sell 1000 copies as of this weekend! We are planning to add an in game Thank You event this coming weekend that will have free limited skins and stuff to collect during the event!

We never thought we'd sell 1000 copies of the game, and are so grateful to all of you. We will keep working hard on updates and new stuff to do!

notes.title: [PATCH 0.2.001] HOTFIXS, NETWORK IMPROVEMENTS, VRAM IMPROVEMENTS
notes.content:
Hey everyone, with the introduction of the difficulty modifiers we introduced a few bugs, but most of them are fixed now.


 Voidspawn and Siren Spawn should no longer one shot the players anymore, regardless of difficulty.
 Soul Jars should no longer clip through the floor in the Backrooms level on Blyatanov.
 Platforming levels should no longer kill clients when jumping on the moving platforms.


We have also found a few areas that were causing potential video memory leaks, and have optimized even more of the networking.



 All portals look much more basic. This is temporary as we figure out what was causing the video memory leak.

 Networking has been further optimized across all aspects of the game.



PLEASE notice, the game has been changed to run in DX11 by default. This may cause temporary shader compiling the first time you play after the update. You can always change back to DX12 by accessing it in your steam launch options. We are trying to find the cause of the VRAM crash some players are experiencing, and it seems it has something to do with the above mentioned memory leak and DX12. Older cards should opt to use DX11, and only newer video cards should use DX12 at the moment. Thank you!

notes.title: [PATCH 0.2.001] New Ranger Rifle and Difficulty Modifiers!
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

We've been hard at work trying to add features and address any issues players have had! With this update, we are excited to share with you a new gun, and a new way to change the difficulty of each mission!


 Ranger Rifle - A new, one shot to the head rifle has been added. Shooting enemies in the head also causes the head to explode and is just fun.



 Difficulty Modifiers - You can now choose new difficulty modifiers when accessing the contract computer. These include more enemies, no ammo/health chests/tools on the map, and higher enemy damage. With each modifier you select, you will earn more credits on a successful extract!


Map Changes 

[olist]
 Kullgrove - The mineshaft layout has been changed to no longer go under the graveyard. This should solve audio issues of mines/enemies/leeches being audible from each location.

 Blyatanov - The garages have been made easier to access from both the school and warehouse locations.

 Favela - The backlots area has been made easier to access from the extraction point of the map.
[/olist]

You may also notice new mysterious areas on each map. These are for the upcoming lore and boss enemy update! You cannot access them quite yet, but you will be able to soon! 

Bug Fixes - 


 Larger hitbox on tool chests for easier looting.
 Void enemies no longer give credits.
 Fixed numerous pop in issues.
 Generator screen should no longer glare with your flashlight. It still gets a little brighter though.
 Fixed enemy collisions in Medical, enemies should no longer walk through certain walls.
 First person footsteps are now 2D, should make them not sound like they are behind the player.
 Spider sounds should no longer be global.
 Siren head should now show on all clients during special event.

notes.title: [PATCH 0.1.014 C] Anomaly Extraction Tool Snaps to your Back!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 
We've been hard at work trying to address some of the annoying glitches and quality of life features players have been asking for. The big one right now, is a change to how the extraction tool works.


 Players will now strap the extraction tool to their back so they can shoot while extracting the anomaly. A yellow icon appears letting you know you have it, and you still can't sprint because it is weighing you down. This should make solo play much less frustrating!


A list of other changes we've made:


 Flashlight no longer points in a random direction after revive.
 Biomass harvesting should no longer bug if you look away while harvesting.
 Picking up items with the video camera equipped should no longer glitch items into your face.
 System message "Unlock Gate" no longer should pop up when revived.
 Disabled "Add Friends" options for non-hosts. This is temporary while we figure out what is causing the crash when clients try to add friends.
 When carrying an artifact, delivery stations should now glow red to show you the closest ones.
 Radio static has been changed to a basic static sound effect, so it should be much easier for players to know when the radio evidence is triggered.
 New system message letting players know they need to stay near the truck when the extraction tool is delivered to the truck so they don't get left behind.


Minor fixes:


 Saloon enemy navigation fixed on Little Creek Map.
 Fixed print evidence sometimes not showing in the Saloon on Little Creek Map.
 Fixed a blocking volume issue on one of the river cabins in Little Creek Map.
 Added missing stairs to one of the cabins on Little Creek map.
 Fixed flickering ground texture on multiple places on Blyatanov map.
 Players can no longer jump on top of the revive stations.
 Gate opening noise has been decreased.

notes.title: [PATCH 0.1.014 B] Aiming Fixes and More!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We have been working on the guns quite a bit, and have made some pretty big fixes for them. Also some exciting news at the end!


 Aiming down sights should feel much better now. Holding down right click will always snap you back to ADS after reloading, even if you let go of right click and then hold it down again.
 All reloading and gun animations have been shortened, so you can get back to aiming much quicker.


Other fixes include:


 Fixed multiple annoying invisible walls.
 Fixed weird LOD issues in the Quarry section of the Little Creek map.
 Fixed enemy collision on some floors in the Campsite section of Little Creek Map.
 Players shouldn't be able to get stuck in the Secret Bunker area of Little Creek.
 When holding the Red Gem, all Gem Refiners should now glow and give a waypoint. Players can find the closest refiner much easier.
 Medical chests have all had their hitboxes increased, should be loot able everywhere now.
 Converted all ammo chests to only one slot, so you don't have to loot as much. Ammo count per stack was increased to keep it the same amount you might find.
 All players no longer hear the biomass harvest squelching sound when another player harvests it.
 All players no longer hear the delivery chest sound effect when another player uses it.
 Soul jar has a larger hitbox, so it should be much easier to pick up when it is next to the backpack.
 You can now pick up the Anomaly Capture tool with Q or E when it has finished capturing.
 Generator event has been made easier, it will be harder only on harder difficulties.
 We are testing some new HUD elements called System Messages. These pop up to help the player understand what to do. We will keep adding these with every patch, so players aren't confused with the many random events they can start. It is just the basic stuff for now, but will get more complete with every patch!


The exciting news? If all goes well, we will have both the Anomaly Capture tool snapping to the players back so they can shoot while extracting, and also the SHOTGUN added by the end of the weekend! As long as we don't blow something up.

Again, thank you all so much for playing the game. We stopped responding to reviews because Steam apparently recommends we don't. But we read every single one of those, and they mean so much to us. We also read every forum post and discord report, so please let us know bugs you find or issues/things you'd like to see. 

Here is a Discord link if you need it! https://discord.com/invite/v5CmYSaFUt

notes.title: [PATCH 0.1.14.A] Quality of Life Hotfix
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
We've made a few quick changes based on feedback, including Fooster!


 You can now use your mouse wheel to change between gun and scanner. Up for gun, down for scanner.
 All switching between guns/tools are now much faster.
 Gun fire sounds have been increased in volume, and made punchier! (Fooster request)
 The lobby tutorial video is now spacial, so you can escape it by simply walking away. (Sorry Fooster.)


This patch did introduce a bug, if you spam between your gun and scanner, other players might see your arm as twisted and broken behind your back. Simply change from scanner back to gun in a non spammy way and it'll fix! We just thought this was a more important hotfix.

Thank you all for playing our game and giving us such important feedback. Please feel free to report bug/criticisms in our discord server or on the steam discussions page.

Here is a Discord link if you need it! https://discord.com/invite/v5CmYSaFUt

notes.title: [PATCH 0.1.014] REVIVE AND GENERAL BUG FIXES UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello everybody, we've been getting a lot of feedback and info on what is causing the revive bugs for some players. We hope we have addressed it in this patch, but please keep reporting bugs with the revive system or anything else so we can fix them as quickly as possible.

Fixes -


 Fixed a spot on the Blyatanov map players could get stuck at.
 Further networking performance improvements, please report any weirdness with online play.
 Fixed an issue with the Backrooms level on the Favela map, players should no longer get stuck in the basement.
 A fourth player will no longer get stuck somewhere weird after using a Backrooms or Platforming level teleporter.
 Revive system should hopefully be working for the majority of players now! No more textureless spawns.
 Biomass reward dropped to 100 per harvest, in preparation for a new system we are introducing soon!
 

Thank you all so much for playing our game, and please give us as much feedback or bug reports over on our discord server as possible!
Here is a link to the server if you need it: https://discord.com/invite/v5CmYSaFUt

notes.title: [PATCH 0.1.013] Revive System Update!
notes.content:
We have included a new revive system to the game!

Biomass has now become its own currency, and you use that at revive stations to revive fallen teammates.

Other Changes Include:


 Brightness slider
 Leeches are a bright green color now, and drip goo. You can see them much, much easier.
 Backrooms and platforming levels are now permanently accessible, each have their own special locations on every map. Try to find them!
 All enemies should now be brighter and easier to see.
 Flashlight is brighter and has an extended range.
 All platforming levels have been made easier.
 Default FPS has been set to 60.
 New highlight for the revive "soul item" when a player dies. You can find their bodies with the new waypoint marker.
 Map order has been changed, with markers for SMALL, MEDIUM, AND LARGE. New players should start on smaller maps!
 Emote system has been changed, you now have access to some funny emotes by default. Still a work in progress though.


Thank you for playing, and all your feedback. Please keep letting us know what you would like to see or added. We post our future patch content over in Discord so feel free to check that out too!

notes.title: [PATCH 0.1.012]
notes.content:
We have included a playable in-game tutorial. You can access it from the starting menu. It is solo only, so be sure to play in a solo group.

Other changes:


 Changed the FOV for first person camera to be wider, and increased the FOV when aiming down sights.
 Increased the fire rate of the SMG.
 Heavily decreased the rate at which sanity declines. We are reworking sanity, and this should make it way less annoying for now!

notes.title: [PATCH 0.1.011]
notes.content:
Hey everyone, this is a pretty big patch so here are the details.

NETWORK STABILITY IMPROVEMENTS


 We have changed up the way our networking works, and players should no longer load in with blank textures, missing inventories, or lack of tools.

 We have temporarily limited the games fps to 60, as higher framerates were causing stability issues for clients. We hope to fix this soon, but for now a 60 fps frame limit will provide a smooth online experience.


NEW ITEMS


 Beacon: Placing this down provides a way point all players can see from any distance to help them navigate to you.
 Blood Scanner: Using this temporarily gives you vision of enemies around you, lasts for one minute.
 Hazard Scanner: Using this temporarily gives you vision of leeches and landmines around you, lasts for one minute.


Changelog:


 Multiple changes to the UI, making it easier to navigate. Evidence log now matches the rest of the UI style.
 Optimized networking load for all players.
 Reduced Smoker spawn rate during fog storms, should make them much more manageable. Even more so in Single Player.

notes.title: [PATCH 0.1.010]
notes.content:
Hey everyone, this is a pretty large Quality of Life update, based on feedback we've received!


 You must now confirm with Lily the Anomaly location before you can leave the extraction zone. (Big red button near the TV's)
 A new icon appears when the final storm begins, to help you find your way to the extraction point.
 A new icon appears when the generator breaks, helping you find your way through the fog.
 A new, temporary icon appears when a player dies. This should make it much easier to find and loot their inventory.
 Checking your in game map, you can now click on a point of interest pin and it will place an icon in the world, helping you navigate to this point easier.


There are also two new hunting items!

 A health visor upgrade, which will show you all nearby health loot boxes in a radius around you. Lasts 60 seconds.
 An ammo visor upgrade, which will show you all nearby ammo loot boxes in a radius around you. Lasts 60 seconds.


Further performance improvements, and fixed some LOD issues with a few things, such as gun scopes.

notes.title: [PATCH 0.1.009]
notes.content:
We are continually taking feedback, and one thing that has been brought up often is players being lost as to where they are on the map. Last patch we added a map you can access at any time by pressing M. We will continue to address this as we get more feedback.

We have now also added a Location Indicator on your HUD, which shows you where you currently are on the map. Used in combination with the Area Map you can access by pressing M, we hope this helps players with their locations!


 Added Locational Indicator
 Reduced cost of SMG significantly.

notes.title: [PATCH 0.1.008] 100 COPIES SOLD, THANK YOU!
notes.content:
Thank you so much for supporting our project! We've just hit 100 sold copies (not including free keys or refunds) and it honestly means so much to us.

If you login during this patch, you can claim a free celebratory gun skin and suit skin to celebrate our milestone! Just visit the GentleBones in the main lobby, and claim your gift!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216710/1e75c73669beab08da05a424776fe3bcdee6a120.png

Also in this patch:


 Players can now press M to view an area map regardless of where they are.
 Scope brightness has been fixed for all scopes.
 Further performance improvements.
 Further collision fixes and loot box fixes.


Once again, thank you for your support! Please keep reporting any bugs here or on our Discord, or anything you would like to see added to the game. We have some major fixes planned for after the holidays, and will be posting our road map soon!

notes.title: [PATCH 0.1.006]
notes.content:
Players now drop their inventory on death. You will find a backpack where they died, containing their inventory.

 Enemies attacks are louder, and shake the player's camera to make it more obvious the player is being hit.

 Basic UI has been updated to make knowing which keys to press easier.

 Major performance improvements on Medium settings and lower.

notes.title: [PATCH 0.01.005]
notes.content:
New Tutorial video in the lobby!

 Further performance improvements on low and ultra low settings.

notes.title: [PATCH 0.1.004]
notes.content:
- Performance improvements across all maps on Low or Ultra Low settings.

- Credit awards increased across all events that award credits.

notes.title: [Patch 0.0.002]
notes.content:
Quick patch based on your feedback!


 Footstep volume reduced.
 Gunshot volume reduced.
 Generator event happens less often, anomaly no longer gets more angry the more people are in EMF range 5. 
 Performance improvements for Little Creek Map on Low Settings.
 Increased latency timer, hopefully less errors when loading a map with 4 people regardless of internet speed.

notes.title: Containment Corp Inc. Releases in Early Access!
notes.content:
Containment Corp Inc. has released in Early Access!  Dive in to a new co-op survival horror game for 1 - 4 players. Contain the anomaly and exterminate enemies in the zone. This is your chance to fight back!

LIMITED TIME CHRISTMAS LAUNCH EVENT

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216710/b1dec19b2bb3a25e75b1dc77967afa2e11b2d0b3.png


 For the rest of the month, you can acquire special Christmas themed customization in game!


 Suit skins and gun skins are waiting to help spread the cheer within the extraction zones. In game currency, not a real money transaction.


SO WHAT IS CONTAINMENT CORP INC?

CONTAINMENT CORP INC. is a co-op survival horror game for 1 - 4 players. Contain the anomaly and exterminate enemies in the zone. This is your chance to fight back!


 1-4 Player CO-OP
 SINGLE PLAYER SCALABILITY
 LOTS OF TOOLS AND WEAPONS
 BONUS OBJECTIVES
 COLLECT LOOT!
 MUCH REPLAYABILITY


EARLY ACCESS INFO

PEER TO PEER (P2P)

Our game utilizes a peer to peer system for online play, so keep that in mind!

OUR PLANS

As a team of only 2 people, we are really proud of Containment Corp. But we always want to add more. Choosing to release the game as early access allows us to continually add new maps, events, and features as time goes on. If you choose to support us during early access, we thank you immensely.
